```{r}

PlayerName <- "JAMES REIMER"

columns= c("Player", "SeasonNumber", "CapHitNumber") 
 
playerrecord = data.frame(matrix(nrow = 8, ncol = length(columns))) 
 
colnames(playerrecord) = columns
 
playerrecord$Player <- PlayerName 

playerrecord$SeasonNumber <- seq(2026,2033)

playerrecord$CapHitNumber <- c(
  
  
   850000 #2026
  ,0 #2027
  ,0 #2028
  ,0 #2029
  ,0 #2030
  ,0  #2031
  ,0  #2032
  ,0  #2033
)
  
playerrecord <- playerrecord %>% filter(CapHitNumber != 0)

TotalContracts <- rbind(TotalContracts, playerrecord)
```

```{r}
save(TotalContracts, file = "TotalContracts.RData")
```
